name: Dubwool
description: Dubwool, the Sheep Pokémon, and the evolved form of Wooloo. A Normal type.
pokedex_entries: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You'll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.
Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.
